definition_one_sentence: A customer account with at least one non-cancelled order in the last 12 months.
formula_or_rule: last_order_date within 12 months AND at least one order with status <> cancelled
example: Order on 2026-03-01 delivered → active on 2026-11-25; only cancelled orders in period → not active
notes_conflicts: Sales keeps a 6-month campaign view via term recently active customer (last_order_date within 6 months); not the company KPI.

definition_one_sentence: Revenue after refunds and excluding VAT (shipping stays in).
notes_conflicts: Sales commission uses amount paid minus refunds INCLUDING VAT — that metric must not be labelled net revenue.

definition_one_sentence: A former active customer with no non-cancelled order in the last 12 months.
formula_or_rule: was active before AND last non-cancelled order_date older than 12 months (or no such order)

definition_one_sentence: A person or organisation holding a ShopFast account (one row in the customer dimension).
formula_or_rule: One row per customer_id in dim_customers / stg_customers
example: customer_id 42 with email a@b.com = one customer
notes_conflicts: One person may hold several accounts (duplicate emails possible upstream).

definition_one_sentence: A single purchase transaction placed by a customer.
formula_or_rule: One row per order_id in fct_orders / stg_orders (all statuses including cancelled)
notes_conflicts: Cancelled orders remain orders but do not count toward active customer.
